Downstream-only visibility may prompt further reruns and renew the same handoff. The selection reset is stipulated; the decision link and recurrent loop are unobserved, and O5 does not establish their causes.

Linked control inspects run-2 tail; ablated arm explicitly selects run-2 full view. Both preserve execution and inspection operations and pay four execution plus one view minute.

Log timing, rerun count, selected run/interval, initiating visibility, following requests, commitments and history. Hypothesis: full visibility enables commitment of B2, CONFIG missing region, run-2, line 8 before scoring within 12 minutes, with at most one full rerun and initiating evidence retained. Unchanged following actions support neither the hypothesized visibility-mediated decision link nor a demonstrated loop.

Shared complementary proposal: separately cross no rerun versus one full rerun with tail versus full inspection. This distinguishes the ATT necessity challenge from the stage1 interface comparison. Hypothesized view-dependent actions favor the visibility account; unchanged actions remain compatible with an independent policy. No successful future is observed.
